## SQA checklist

- [ ] Branch and PR title reference the actual Jira key
- [ ] Acceptance criteria and positive/negative scenarios covered
- [ ] SQA Gate passed on this revision
- [ ] Test results and environment linked; no invented results
- [ ] Independent teammate review requested and feedback resolved
- [ ] Security, permissions, CSRF and input validation checked where relevant
- [ ] No credentials, production data or private configuration committed
- [ ] Related Test Cases/Bugs updated with actual evidence
- [ ] Documentation and rollback impact recorded
